headline: Disney D23 2026: Everything announced for Star Wars, Marvel, and more
summary: D23 revealed Marvel's X-Men movie cast and an 'Avengers: Doomsday' trailer. 'VisionQuest' TV show and 'Ahsoka' season two teaser also debuted. 'Star Wars: Starfighter' also got a special look.

headline: I finally found a magnetic phone grip I never want to remove
summary: Reviewer initially resisted OhSnap accessories due to price and flaws. Previous preference was for a cheaper Syncwire grip. The new $50 OhSnap Snap Grip Stand finally won them over.

headline: Marvel reveals the new X-Men cast, including Inde Navarrette and Adam Driver
summary: Marvel officially announced the cast for its upcoming X-Men film. Inde Navarrette and Adam Driver are among the new additions. The movie is set to release on May 5th.

headline: Xteink’s tiny e-readers are getting access to free books through Libby
summary: Xteink e-readers previously lacked easy access to ebooks. Unlike Kindle or Kobo, users sourced DRM-free books themselves. This changes with new Libby integration for free access.

headline: Star Trek’s Babs Olusanmokun on the End of Strange New Worlds: ‘I Don't See It as a Final Episode’
summary: Babs Olusanmokun, Dr. M'Benga in Star Trek: Strange New Worlds, discusses the show's ending. He believes it is not a "final episode" despite its conclusion. His comments hint at potential future for the series.

headline: Who Needs Wolverine? Why We're Pumped for Marvel's X-Men Reboot | D23 2026
summary: Marvel's X-Men reboot notably excludes Wolverine. This absence is highlighted as a positive for a fresh take. Fans are excited for the new direction revealed at D23 2026.

headline: I Hope GTA 6 Borrows a Lot From GTA 4
summary: Reviewer is replaying Grand Theft Auto 4 for the first time since 2008. They hope GTA 6 incorporates elements from the acclaimed previous title. Specific aspects desired from GTA 4 are hinted at for the new game.

headline: Frozen 3 Footage Teases New Villain, and It Looks Like Olaf is Getting a Love Interest
summary: Disney showcased initial footage for Frozen 3 at its D23 fan event. The teaser reveals a new antagonist for the animated sequel. Intriguingly, it hints at a potential love interest for Olaf.

headline: Jason Arday death 'tragedy on so many levels' says PM
summary: The Prime Minister described Jason Arday's death as a multi-faceted tragedy. Andy Burnham called it a "sad and sorry state of affairs." Arday was a former Cambridge professor.

headline: Analysis: Arday's death will send shockwaves through a divided academia
summary: Jason Arday's death is expected to deeply impact the academic community. He was among the rare 1% of black UK university professors. His passing highlights diversity issues within academia, writes Education Editor Branwen Jeffreys.

headline: Powerful magnitude 7.7 earthquake kills at least 47 in Indonesia
summary: A massive 7.7 magnitude earthquake struck Indonesia, claiming at least 47 lives. Search and rescue operations are underway. Efforts focus on finding survivors on Flores island.

headline: Bonnie Tyler fans line the streets as coffin taken to her Swansea home
summary: Fans gathered in Swansea to pay respects to Bonnie Tyler. Her coffin was transported to her home. The 'Total Eclipse of the Heart' singer passed away last month in Portugal.
